description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a numbered list with exact formatting, spacing, and ordering, without drift or reinterpretation.

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output the three numbered lines exactly as provided, preserving numbering, periods, casing, and line breaks.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if all three lines match exactly with correct numbering and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing errors, or incorrect line structure.
